functions.description: Parse base osfsd log line: timestamp, host, pid, severity, event code, and message body
Default severity to INFO and classify action based on message content

add.name: action
add.value: message.match(/Successfully opened volume/) ? 'open' : message.match(/heartbeat update delayed/) ? 'heartbeat_delay' : message.match(/Lock acquired/) ? 'lock_acquired' : message.match(/Failed to acquire lock/) ? 'lock_failed' : message.match(/Closing volume/) ? 'close' : message.match(/latency exceeded threshold/) ? 'latency_warning' : message.match(/Metadata scan completed/) ? 'metadata_scan' : message.match(/Volume open failed/) ? 'open_failed' : message.match(/Lock released/) ? 'lock_released' : message.match(/not responding/) ? 'nfs_unresponsive' : message.match(/Heartbeat lost/) ? 'heartbeat_lost' : message.match(/Unusual lock contention/) ? 'lock_contention' : 'unknown'
